+    CLAUSE_KEYWORDS = {"from", "where", "group", "order", "limit", "offset", "into"}
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[Token], raw_query: str) -> None:
+        self.stream = TokenStream(tokens)
+        self.raw_query = raw_query
+
+    def parse(self) -> Query:
+        self.stream.match("select")
+        select_exprs = self.parse_expression_list(stop_keywords=self.CLAUSE_KEYWORDS, unknown_as_field=False)
+        roots: list[RootSpec] = []
+        where_expr: Optional[Expr] = None
+        group_by: list[Expr] = []
+        order_by: list[OrderSpec] = []
+        limit: Optional[int] = None
+        offset = 0
+        fmt = "tabs"
+
+        while not self.stream.at_end():
+            if self.stream.match("from"):
+                roots = self.parse_roots()
+            elif self.stream.match("where"):
+                where_expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=True)
+            elif self.stream.match("group"):
+                self.stream.expect("by")
+                group_by = self.parse_expression_list(stop_keywords={"order", "limit", "offset", "into"}, unknown_as_field=False)
+            elif self.stream.match("order"):
+                self.stream.expect("by")
+                order_by = self.parse_order_list()
+            elif self.stream.match("limit"):
+                limit = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
+            elif self.stream.match("offset"):
+                offset = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
+            elif self.stream.match("into"):
+                token = self.stream.next()
+                fmt = token.value.lower()
+            else:
+                unexpected = self.stream.next().value
+                raise ParseError(f"Unexpected token {unexpected}")
+
+        return Query(
+            select_exprs=select_exprs,
+            roots=roots,
+            where_expr=where_expr,
+            group_by=group_by,
+            order_by=order_by,
+            limit=limit,
+            offset=offset,
+            fmt=fmt,
+            raw_query=self.raw_query,
+        )
+
+    def parse_roots(self) -> list[RootSpec]:
+        roots: list[RootSpec] = []
+        while True:
+            roots.append(self.parse_root())
+            if not self.stream.match(","):
+                break
+        return roots
+
+    def parse_root(self) -> RootSpec:
+        token = self.stream.next()
+        if token.kind not in {"word", "string"}:
+            raise ParseError("Expected root path")
+        root = RootSpec(path=token.value)
+        while True:
+            next_token = self.stream.peek()
+            if next_token is None:
+                break
+            lowered = next_token.lower()
+            if lowered in self.CLAUSE_KEYWORDS or lowered == ",":
+                break
+            self.stream.next()
+            if lowered == "mindepth":
+                root.mindepth = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
+            elif lowered in {"maxdepth", "depth"}:
+                root.maxdepth = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
+            elif lowered in {"symlinks", "sym"}:
+                root.symlinks = True
+            elif lowered in {"archives", "arc"}:
+                root.archives = True
+            elif lowered in {"gitignore", "git"}:
+                root.gitignore = True
+            elif lowered in {"nogitignore", "nogit"}:
+                root.gitignore = False
+            elif lowered in {"hgignore", "hg"}:
+                root.hgignore = True
+            elif lowered in {"nohgignore", "nohg"}:
+                root.hgignore = False
+            elif lowered in {"dockerignore", "docker", "dock"}:
+                root.dockerignore = True
+            elif lowered in {"nodockerignore", "nodocker", "nodock"}:
+                root.dockerignore = False
+            elif lowered == "dfs":
+                root.dfs = True
+                root.bfs = False
+            elif lowered == "bfs":
+                root.bfs = True
+                root.dfs = False
+            elif lowered in {"regexp", "rx"}:
+                root.regexp = True
+            elif lowered == "as":
+                root.alias = self.stream.expect_identifier()
+            else:
+                # Bare alias is not supported; unknown path options are ignored like the original parser often does.
+                pass
+        return root
+
+    def parse_order_list(self) -> list[OrderSpec]:
+        items: list[OrderSpec] = []
+        while True:
+            token = self.stream.peek()
+            if token is None:
+                break
+            positional_index: Optional[int] = None
+            if token.kind in {"word", "string"} and re.fullmatch(r"\d+", token.value):
+                positional_index = int(token.value)
+                expr: Expr = LiteralExpr(positional_index, raw=token.value)
+                self.stream.next()
+            else:
+                expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=False)
+            desc = False
+            if self.stream.match("desc"):
+                desc = True
+            else:
+                self.stream.match("asc")
+            items.append(OrderSpec(expr=expr, desc=desc, positional_index=positional_index))
+            if not self.stream.match(","):
+                break
+        return items
+
+    def parse_expression_list(self, stop_keywords: set[str], unknown_as_field: bool) -> list[Expr]:
+        expressions: list[Expr] = []
+        while True:
+            token = self.stream.peek()
+            if token is None:
+                break
+            if token.lower() in stop_keywords:
+                break
+            expressions.append(self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=unknown_as_field))
+            token = self.stream.peek()
+            if token is None or token.lower() in stop_keywords:
+                break
+            self.stream.match(",")
+        if not expressions:
+            raise ParseError("Expected columns")
+        return expressions
+
+    def parse_or_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        expr = self.parse_and_expression(unknown_as_field)
+        while self.stream.match("or"):
+            expr = BinaryExpr("or", expr, self.parse_and_expression(unknown_as_field))
+        return expr
+
+    def parse_and_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        expr = self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field)
+        while self.stream.match("and"):
+            expr = BinaryExpr("and", expr, self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field))
+        return expr
+
+    def parse_not_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        if self.stream.match("not"):
+            if self.stream.match("exists"):
+                subquery = self.parse_subquery()
+                return ExistsExpr(subquery, negated=True)
+            return UnaryExpr("not", self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field))
+        if self.stream.match("exists"):
+            subquery = self.parse_subquery()
+            return ExistsExpr(subquery, negated=False)
+        return self.parse_comparison_expression(unknown_as_field)
+
+    def parse_comparison_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        expr = self.parse_additive_expression(unknown_as_field)
+        token = self.stream.peek()
+        if token is None:
+            return expr
+        lowered = token.lower()
+
+        if lowered == "between":
+            self.stream.next()
+            low = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
+            self.stream.expect("and")
+            high = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
+            return BetweenExpr(expr, low, high)
+        if lowered == "not" and self.stream.peek(1) and self.stream.peek(1).lower() == "between":
+            self.stream.next()
+            self.stream.next()
+            low = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
+            self.stream.expect("and")
+            high = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
+            return BetweenExpr(expr, low, high, negated=True)
+        if lowered == "in":
+            self.stream.next()
+            return self.parse_in_expression(expr, negated=False)
+        if lowered == "not" and self.stream.peek(1) and self.stream.peek(1).lower() == "in":
+            self.stream.next()
+            self.stream.next()
+            return self.parse_in_expression(expr, negated=True)
+        if lowered in {"like", "notlike", "=", "==", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", "===", "eeq", "!==", "ene", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "le", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "ge", "=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx", "!=~", "!~=", "notrx"}:
+            op = self.stream.next().lower()
+            right = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
+            return BinaryExpr(op, expr, right)
+        return expr
+
+    def parse_in_expression(self, expr: Expr, negated: bool) -> Expr:
+        self.stream.expect("(")
+        if self.stream.peek() and self.stream.peek().lower() == "select":
+            subquery = self.parse_subquery_contents()
+            self.stream.expect(")")
+            return InExpr(expr, subquery=subquery, negated=negated)
+        items: list[Expr] = []
+        while True:
+            items.append(self.parse_or_expression(False))
+            if not self.stream.match(","):
+                break
+        self.stream.expect(")")
+        return InExpr(expr, options=items, negated=negated)
+
+    def parse_subquery(self) -> Query:
+        self.stream.expect("(")
+        query = self.parse_subquery_contents()
+        self.stream.expect(")")
+        return query
+
+    def parse_subquery_contents(self) -> Query:
+        depth = 0
+        start = self.stream.index
+        index = self.stream.index
+        while index < len(self.stream.tokens):
+            token = self.stream.tokens[index]
+            if token.value == "(":
+                depth += 1
+            elif token.value == ")":
+                if depth == 0:
+                    break
+                depth -= 1
+            index += 1
+        inner_tokens = self.stream.tokens[start:index]
+        self.stream.index = index
+        return Parser(inner_tokens, " ".join(token.value for token in inner_tokens)).parse()
+
+    def parse_additive_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        expr = self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field)
+        while True:
+            if self.stream.match("+", "plus"):
+                expr = BinaryExpr("+", expr, self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field))
+            elif self.stream.match("-", "minus"):
+                expr = BinaryExpr("-", expr, self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field))
+            else:
+                break
+        return expr
+
+    def parse_multiplicative_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        expr = self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field)
+        while True:
+            if self.stream.match("*", "mul"):
+                expr = BinaryExpr("*", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
+            elif self.stream.match("/", "div"):
+                expr = BinaryExpr("/", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
+            elif self.stream.match("%", "mod"):
+                expr = BinaryExpr("%", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
+            else:
+                break
+        return expr
+
+    def parse_unary_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        if self.stream.match("+"):
+            return UnaryExpr("+", self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
+        if self.stream.match("-"):
+            return UnaryExpr("-", self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
+        return self.parse_primary(unknown_as_field)
+
+    def parse_primary(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
+        token = self.stream.peek()
+        if token is None:
+            raise ParseError("Unexpected end of query")
+        if token.value == "(":
+            self.stream.next()
+            expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field)
+            self.stream.expect(")")
+            return expr
+        if token.kind == "string":
+            self.stream.next()
+            return LiteralExpr(token.value, raw=token.value)
+        if token.value == "*":
+            self.stream.next()
+            return StarExpr()
+
+        word = self.stream.next()
+        lowered = word.lower()
+
+        if self.stream.peek() and self.stream.peek().value == "(":
+            self.stream.next()
+            args: list[Expr] = []
+            if not self.stream.match(")"):
+                while True:
+                    args.append(self.parse_or_expression(False))
+                    if self.stream.match(")"):
+                        break
+                    self.stream.expect(",")
+            return FunctionExpr(word.value, args)
+
+        if lowered in NO_ARG_FUNCTIONS:
+            return FunctionExpr(word.value, [])
+        if lowered in BOOLEAN_TRUE:
+            return LiteralExpr(True, raw=word.value)
+        if lowered in BOOLEAN_FALSE:
+            return LiteralExpr(False, raw=word.value)
+        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", word.value):
+            if "." in word.value:
+                return LiteralExpr(float(word.value), raw=word.value)
+            return LiteralExpr(int(word.value), raw=word.value)
+        if "." in word.value and not word.value.startswith(".") and not word.value.endswith(".") and "/" not in word.value:
+            alias, field_name = word.value.split(".", 1)
+            return FieldExpr(field_name, alias=alias)
+        if word.kind == "string":
+            return LiteralExpr(word.value, raw=word.value)
+        if unknown_as_field or lowered in KNOWN_FIELDS:
+            return FieldExpr(word.value)
+        return LiteralExpr(word.value, raw=word.value)
+
+
+def execute_query(query: Query, runtime: Runtime, outer_alias_rows: Optional[dict[str, FileRow]] = None) -> ResultTable:
+    outer_alias_rows = outer_alias_rows or {}
+    rows = scan_rows(query, runtime)
+    filtered: list[FileRow] = []
+    for row in rows:
+        env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
+        if query.where_expr is None or truthy(query.where_expr.eval(env)):
+            filtered.append(row)
+
+    labels = [expr.label() for expr in query.select_exprs]
+    result_rows: list[ResultRow] = []
+
+    if query.group_by:
+        grouped: dict[tuple[Any, ...], list[FileRow]] = {}
+        for row in filtered:
+            env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
+            key = tuple(expr.eval(env) for expr in query.group_by)
+            grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(row)
+        for group_rows in grouped.values():
+            current = group_rows[0]
+            env = EvalEnv(
+                runtime=runtime,
+                current_row=current,
+                alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(current)},
+                group_rows=group_rows,
+            )
+            values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
+            result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=current))
+    elif query.has_aggregate():
+        current = filtered[0] if filtered else None
+        env = EvalEnv(
+            runtime=runtime,
+            current_row=current,
+            alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **(alias_rows_for_row(current) if current else {})},
+            group_rows=filtered,
+        )
+        values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
+        result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=current))
+    else:
+        for row in filtered:
+            env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
+            values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
+            result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=row))
+
+    if query.order_by:
+        def sort_key(result_row: ResultRow) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+            values: list[Any] = []
+            for spec in query.order_by:
+                if spec.positional_index is not None:
+                    idx = spec.positional_index - 1
+                    value = result_row.values[idx] if 0 <= idx < len(result_row.values) else ""
+                else:
+                    env = EvalEnv(
+                        runtime=runtime,
+                        current_row=result_row.current_row,
+                        alias_rows=result_row.alias_rows,
+                        group_rows=[result_row.current_row] if result_row.current_row else [],
+                    )
+                    value = spec.expr.eval(env)
+                values.append(value)
+            return tuple(normalize_sort_value(v) for v in values)
+
+        for spec_index in range(len(query.order_by) - 1, -1, -1):
+            spec = query.order_by[spec_index]
+            result_rows.sort(
+                key=lambda row, idx=spec_index: normalize_sort_value(
+                    row.values[query.order_by[idx].positional_index - 1]
+                    if query.order_by[idx].positional_index is not None and 0 <= query.order_by[idx].positional_index - 1 < len(row.values)
+                    else EvalEnv(
+                        runtime=runtime,
+                        current_row=row.current_row,
+                        alias_rows=row.alias_rows,
+                        group_rows=[row.current_row] if row.current_row else [],
+                    ).call_function("coalesce", [query.order_by[idx].expr])
+                ),
+                reverse=spec.desc,
+            )
+
+    if query.offset:
+        result_rows = result_rows[query.offset :]
+    if query.limit is not None:
+        result_rows = result_rows[: query.limit]
+
+    return ResultTable(rows=result_rows, labels=labels, raw_query=query.raw_query, fmt=query.fmt)
+
+
+def normalize_sort_value(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if value is None:
+        return ""
+    return value
+
+
+def scan_rows(query: Query, runtime: Runtime) -> list[FileRow]:
+    roots = query.roots or [RootSpec(path=".")]
+    rows: list[FileRow] = []
+    for root in roots:
+        rows.extend(scan_root(root, runtime))
+    return rows
+
+
+def scan_root(root: RootSpec, runtime: Runtime) -> list[FileRow]:
+    candidate = Path(root.path)
+    if not candidate.is_absolute():
+        candidate = runtime.cwd / candidate
+    try:
+        resolved = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: could not canonicalize path: No such file or directory (os error 2)")
+    if not resolved.is_dir():
+        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: Not a directory (os error 20)")
+
+    rows: list[FileRow] = []
+    pending: deque[tuple[Path, int]] = deque()
+    try:
+        entries = list(os.scandir(resolved))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})")
+
+    for entry in entries:
+        pending.append((Path(entry.path), 1))
+
+    while pending:
+        path, depth = pending.pop() if root.dfs else pending.popleft()
+        rel_path = os.path.relpath(path, resolved)
+        row = FileRow(runtime, root, resolved, path, rel_path)
+        if depth >= root.mindepth and (root.maxdepth is None or depth <= root.maxdepth):
+            rows.append(row)
+        if root.maxdepth is not None and depth >= root.maxdepth:
+            continue
+        try:
+            if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink():
+                for child in os.scandir(path):
+                    pending.append((Path(child.path), depth + 1))
+        except OSError as exc:
+            raise QueryIOError(f"{path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})")
+    return rows
+
+
+def format_result(table: ResultTable) -> str:
+    fmt = table.fmt.lower()
+    if fmt == "tabs":
+        if not table.rows:
+            return ""
+        return "".join("\t".join(stringify_value(value) for value in row.values) + "\n" for row in table.rows)
+    if fmt == "lines":
+        if not table.rows:
+            return ""
+        return "".join("".join(stringify_value(value) + "\n" for value in row.values) for row in table.rows)
+    if fmt == "list":
+        return "".join("".join(stringify_value(value) + "\0" for value in row.values) for row in table.rows)
+    if fmt == "csv":
+        output = []
+        for row in table.rows:
+            buffer = []
+            for value in row.values:
+                buffer.append(stringify_value(value))
+            output.append(buffer)
+        from io import StringIO
+
+        handle = StringIO()
+        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
+        writer.writerows(output)
+        return handle.getvalue()
+    if fmt == "json":
+        objects = []
+        for row in table.rows:
+            pairs = sorted(zip(row.labels, row.values), key=lambda pair: pair[0])
+            objects.append({label: stringify_value(value) for label, value in pairs})
+        return json.dumps(objects, separators=(",", ":"))
+    if fmt == "html":
+        cell_rows = []
+        for row in table.rows:
+            cells = "".join(f"<td>{html.escape(stringify_value(value))}</td>" for value in row.values)
+            cell_rows.append(f"<tr>{cells}</tr>")
+        title = html.escape(table.raw_query)
+        return f"<html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><table><tr><th colspan=\"{max(1, len(table.labels))}\">{title}</th></tr>{''.join(cell_rows)}</table></body></html>"
+    return format_result(ResultTable(rows=table.rows, labels=table.labels, raw_query=table.raw_query, fmt="tabs"))
+
+
+def run_query(query_text: str, runtime: Runtime) -> str:
+    tokens = tokenize(query_text)
+    if not tokens:
+        raise ParseError("Unexpected end of query")
+    parser = Parser(tokens, query_text)
+    query = parser.parse()
+    table = execute_query(query, runtime)
+    return format_result(table)
+
+
+def interactive_loop(runtime: Runtime, config_path: Path) -> int:
+    while True:
+        try:
+            line = input("query> ")
+        except EOFError:
+            print("CTRL-D")
+            return 0
+        append_history(config_path, line)
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        lowered = stripped.lower()
+        if lowered in {"exit", "quit"}:
+            return 0
+        if not stripped:
+            continue
+        if lowered == "help":
+            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
+            continue
+        if lowered == "pwd":
+            print(runtime.cwd)
+            continue
+        if lowered.startswith("cd "):
+            target = stripped[3:].strip()
+            candidate = Path(target)
+            if not candidate.is_absolute():
+                candidate = runtime.cwd / candidate
+            try:
+                runtime.cwd = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
+            except OSError:
+                pass
+            continue
+        if lowered in {"errors", "errors on"}:
+            runtime.no_errors = False
+            print("Errors are ON")
+            continue
+        if lowered == "errors off":
+            runtime.no_errors = True
+            print("Errors are OFF")
+            continue
+        try:
+            output = run_query(stripped, runtime)
+            sys.stdout.write(output)
+        except ParseError as exc:
+            if not runtime.no_errors:
+                print(f"query: {exc}")
+        except QueryIOError as exc:
+            if not runtime.no_errors:
+                print(exc)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    try:
+        options = parse_runtime_options(argv)
+    except ParseError as exc:
+        print(f"query: {exc}")
+        return 2
+
+    config, warning, config_path = ensure_config(options)
+    config.no_color = config.no_color or options.no_color or bool(os.environ.get("NO_COLOR"))
+    us_dates = options.us_dates or config.us_dates
+    runtime = Runtime(cwd=Path.cwd(), config=config, no_errors=options.no_errors, us_dates=us_dates)
+
+    if options.interactive:
+        if warning:
+            sys.stdout.write(warning)
+        return interactive_loop(runtime, config_path)
+    if options.help_requested:
+        sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
+        return 0
+    if options.version_requested or not options.query_parts:
+        sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
+        return 0
+
+    if warning:
+        sys.stdout.write(warning)
+
+    query_text = " ".join(options.query_parts)
+    try:
+        output = run_query(query_text, runtime)
+    except ParseError as exc:
+        if not runtime.no_errors:

class TokenStream:
    def __init__(self, tokens: list[Token]) -> None:
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.index = 0

    def peek(self, offset: int = 0) -> Optional[Token]:
        idx = self.index + offset
        if 0 <= idx < len(self.tokens):
            return self.tokens[idx]
        return None

    def next(self) -> Token:
        token = self.peek()
        if token is None:
            raise ParseError("Unexpected end of query")
        self.index += 1
        return token

    def match(self, *values: str) -> Optional[Token]:
        token = self.peek()
        if token and token.lower() in values:
            self.index += 1
            return token
        return None

    def match_value(self, value: str) -> bool:
        token = self.peek()
        return token is not None and token.lower() == value

    def expect(self, *values: str) -> Token:
        token = self.next()
        if token.lower() not in values:
            expected = " or ".join(values)
            raise ParseError(f"Expected {expected}")
        return token

    def at_end(self) -> bool:
        return self.peek() is None

        if self.op == "-":

        if self.op == "+":

        if self.op == "not":

        if self.op == "or":
            return truthy(self.left.eval(env)) or truthy(self.right.eval(env))
        left = self.left.eval(env)
        right = self.right.eval(env)
        return env.evaluate_binary(self.op, left, right, self.left, self.right)

    def label(self) -> str:
        word = {
            "+": "Add",
            "-": "Subtract",
            "*": "Multiply",
            "/": "Divide",
            "%": "Modulo",
            "and": "And",
            "or": "Or",
        }.get(self.op, self.op.title())
        return f"{self.left.label()} {word} {self.right.label()}"

    def has_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.left.has_aggregate() or self.right.has_aggregate()

            return len(stringify_value(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "to_base64":
            return base64.b64encode(stringify_value(values[0]).encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii") if values else ""
        if canonical == "from_base64":
            try:
                return base64.b64decode(stringify_value(values[0])).decode("utf-8")
            except Exception:
                return ""
        if canonical == "concat":
            return "".join(stringify_value(v) for v in values)
        if canonical == "concat_ws":
            if not values:
                return ""
            separator = stringify_value(values[0])
            return separator.join(stringify_value(v) for v in values[1:])
        if canonical == "locate":
            if len(values) >= 2:
                return stringify_value(values[0]).find(stringify_value(values[1])) + 1
            return 0
        if canonical == "substr":
            if not values:
                return ""
            text = stringify_value(values[0])
            if len(values) < 2:
                return text
            start = int(to_number(values[1])) - 1
            if len(values) < 3:
                return text[start:]
            length = int(to_number(values[2]))
            return text[start : start + length]
        if canonical == "replace":
            if len(values) < 3:
                return stringify_value(values[0]) if values else ""
            return stringify_value(values[0]).replace(stringify_value(values[1]), stringify_value(values[2]))
        if canonical == "trim":
            return stringify_value(values[0]).strip() if values else ""
        if canonical == "ltrim":
            return stringify_value(values[0]).lstrip() if values else ""
        if canonical == "rtrim":
            return stringify_value(values[0]).rstrip() if values else ""
        if canonical == "contains_japanese":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9faf]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "contains_hiragana":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u3040-\u309f]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "contains_katakana":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u30a0-\u30ff]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "contains_kana":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u3040-\u30ff]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "contains_kanji":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u4e00-\u9faf]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "contains_greek":
            return bool(re.search(r"[\u0370-\u03ff]", stringify_value(values[0]))) if values else False
        if canonical == "bin":
            return format(int(to_number(values[0])), "b") if values else ""
        if canonical == "hex":
            return format(int(to_number(values[0])), "x") if values else ""
        if canonical == "oct":
            return format(int(to_number(values[0])), "o") if values else ""
        if canonical == "abs":
            return abs(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "power":
            return math.pow(to_number(values[0]), to_number(values[1])) if len(values) >= 2 else 0
        if canonical == "sqrt":
            return math.sqrt(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "log":
            if len(values) >= 2:
                return math.log(to_number(values[0]), to_number(values[1]))
            return math.log(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "ln":
            return math.log(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "exp":
            return math.exp(to_number(values[0])) if values else 1
        if canonical == "least":
            return min(values) if values else ""
        if canonical == "greatest":
            return max(values) if values else ""
        if canonical == "pi":
            return math.pi
        if canonical == "floor":
            return math.floor(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "ceil":
            return math.ceil(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "round":
            if len(values) >= 2:
                return round(to_number(values[0]), int(to_number(values[1])))
            return round(to_number(values[0])) if values else 0
        if canonical == "rand":
            if len(values) == 2:
                lo = int(to_number(values[0]))
                hi = int(to_number(values[1]))
                return random.randint(lo, hi)
            if len(values) == 1:
                hi = int(to_number(values[0]))
                return random.randint(0, hi)
            return random.random()
        if canonical in {"current_date", "cur_date", "curdate"}:
            return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        if canonical in {"current_time", "cur_time", "curtime"}:
            return datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        if canonical in {"current_timestamp", "now"}:
            return datetime.now().strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)
        if canonical == "day":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "day")
        if canonical == "month":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "month")
        if canonical == "year":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "year")
        if canonical == "dow":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "dow")
        if canonical == "dayname":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "dayname")
        if canonical == "doy":
            return extract_date_part(values[0], "doy")
        if canonical == "date_add":
            date_value = parse_datetime_value(values[0], self.runtime.us_dates)
            if date_value is None:
                return ""
            return (date_value + timedelta(days=int(to_number(values[1])))).strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)
        if canonical == "date_sub":
            date_value = parse_datetime_value(values[0], self.runtime.us_dates)
            if date_value is None:
                return ""
            return (date_value - timedelta(days=int(to_number(values[1])))).strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)
        if canonical == "date_diff":
            left = parse_datetime_value(values[0], self.runtime.us_dates)
            right = parse_datetime_value(values[1], self.runtime.us_dates)
            if left is None or right is None:
                return ""
            return (left.date() - right.date()).days
        if canonical == "from_unixtime":
            return datetime.fromtimestamp(to_number(values[0])).strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT) if values else ""
        if canonical == "last_day":
            date_value = parse_datetime_value(values[0], self.runtime.us_dates)
            if date_value is None:
                return ""
            month = date_value.month
            year = date_value.year
            if month == 12:
                next_month = datetime(year + 1, 1, 1)
            else:
                next_month = datetime(year, month + 1, 1)
            return (next_month - timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        if canonical == "format_size":
            if not values:
                return ""
            spec = stringify_value(values[1]) if len(values) > 1 else self.runtime.config.default_file_size_format
            return format_size(to_number(values[0]), spec)
        if canonical == "format_time":
            return format_duration(to_number(values[0])) if values else ""
        if canonical == "current_uid":
            return os.getuid()
        if canonical == "current_user":
            try:
                return pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
            except KeyError:
                return os.getuid()
        if canonical == "current_gid":
            return os.getgid()
        if canonical == "current_group":
            try:
                return grp.getgrgid(os.getgid()).gr_name
            except KeyError:
                return os.getgid()
        if canonical == "contains":
            if not self.current_row:
                return False
            needle = stringify_value(values[-1]) if values else ""
            return self.current_row.contains(needle)
        if canonical == "coalesce":
            for value in values:
                if value not in (None, ""):
                    return value
            return ""
        if canonical == "has_xattr":
            if len(values) != 1 or not self.current_row:
                return False
            return self.current_row.has_xattr(stringify_value(values[0]))
        if canonical == "xattr":
            if len(values) != 1 or not self.current_row:
                return ""
            return self.current_row.xattr(stringify_value(values[0]))
        if canonical == "has_extattr":
            if len(values) != 1 or not self.current_row:
                return False
            return stringify_value(values[0]) in stringify_value(self.current_row.get("extattrs"))
        if canonical == "has_acl_entry":
            return False
        if canonical == "acl_entry":
            return ""
        if canonical == "has_default_acl_entry":
            return False
        if canonical == "default_acl_entry":
            return ""
        if canonical == "has_capability":
            return False
        return ""

    def evaluate_binary(self, op: str, left: Any, right: Any, left_expr: Expr, right_expr: Expr) -> Any:
        if op in {"+", "-", "*", "/", "%"}:
            lnum = to_number(left)
            rnum = to_number(right)
            if op == "+":
                return lnum + rnum
            if op == "-":
                return lnum - rnum
            if op == "*":
                return lnum * rnum
            if op == "/":
                return lnum / rnum if rnum != 0 else 0
            return lnum % rnum if rnum != 0 else 0
        return compare_values(self, left, right, left_expr, right_expr, op)


class FileRow:

        self.runtime = runtime
        self.root = root
        self.root_path = root_path
        self.path = path
        self.rel_path = rel_path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        self._cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._lstat = path.lstat()
        self._stat = path.stat() if root.symlinks else self._lstat

    def get(self, field_name: str) -> Any:

        elif field_name == "filename":
            value = split_name_ext(self.path.name)[0]
        elif field_name == "ext":

        elif field_name == "path":
            value = self.rel_path
        elif field_name == "abspath":

        elif field_name == "dir":
            value = self.rel_path.rsplit("/", 1)[0] if "/" in self.rel_path else ""
        elif field_name == "absdir":
            value = str(self.path.parent)
        elif field_name == "size":
            value = self._stat.st_size
        elif field_name == "hsize":
            value = format_size(self._stat.st_size, self.runtime.config.default_file_size_format)
        elif field_name == "uid":
            value = self._stat.st_uid
        elif field_name == "gid":
            value = self._stat.st_gid
        elif field_name == "user":
            try:
                value = pwd.getpwuid(self._stat.st_uid).pw_name
            except KeyError:
                value = self._stat.st_uid
        elif field_name == "group":
            try:
                value = grp.getgrgid(self._stat.st_gid).gr_name
            except KeyError:
                value = self._stat.st_gid
        elif field_name == "created":

        elif field_name == "accessed":

        elif field_name == "modified":

        elif field_name == "mtime":

        elif field_name == "is_dir":

        elif field_name == "is_file":
            value = statmod.S_ISREG(self._stat.st_mode)
        elif field_name == "is_symlink":
            value = statmod.S_ISLNK(self._lstat.st_mode)
        elif field_name == "is_pipe":

        elif field_name == "is_char":

        elif field_name == "is_block":

        elif field_name == "device":

        elif field_name == "inode":

        elif field_name == "blocks":

        elif field_name == "mode":

        elif field_name == "acl":

        }:
            value = ""
        elif field_name == "mime":
            value = self._mime_type()
        elif field_name == "line_count":
            value = self._line_count()
        elif field_name == "is_binary":

        elif field_name == "is_text":
            value = not self._is_binary()
        elif field_name in CATEGORY_KEYS:
            value = self._has_extension(self.runtime.config.type_lists.get(field_name, set()))
        elif field_name == "sha1":
            value = self._hash_file("sha1")
        elif field_name == "sha256":
            value = self._hash_file("sha256")
        elif field_name == "sha512":
            value = self._hash_file("sha512")
        elif field_name == "sha3":
