    def contains(self, needle: str) -> bool:
        if not needle:
            return True
        try:
            with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                return needle.encode("utf-8") in handle.read()
        except OSError:
            return False

    def has_xattr(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self._list_xattrs()

    def xattr(self, name: str) -> str:
        if not hasattr(os, "getxattr"):
            return ""
        try:
            return os.getxattr(self.path, name).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
        except OSError:
            return ""

    def _list_xattrs(self) -> list[str]:
        if not hasattr(os, "listxattr"):
            return []
        try:
            return list(os.listxattr(self.path))
        except OSError:
            return []

    def _is_empty(self) -> bool:
        if statmod.S_ISDIR(self._stat.st_mode):
            try:
                return not any(self.path.iterdir())
            except OSError:
                return False
        return self._stat.st_size == 0

    def _starts_with_shebang(self) -> bool:
        try:
            with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                return handle.read(2) == b"#!"
        except OSError:
            return False

    def _mime_type(self) -> str:
        if statmod.S_ISDIR(self._stat.st_mode):
            return "inode/directory"
        extension = self.path.suffix.lower()
        if extension == ".sh":
            return "application/x-shellscript"
        try:
            with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                chunk = handle.read(8192)
        except OSError:
            chunk = b""
        if not chunk:
            return "text/plain"
        if b"\x00" in chunk:
            guessed, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(self.path.name)
            return guessed or "application/octet-stream"
        try:
            chunk.decode("utf-8")
            return "text/plain"
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            guessed, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(self.path.name)
            return guessed or "application/octet-stream"

    def _is_binary(self) -> bool:
        return not self._mime_type().startswith("text/") and self._mime_type() != "application/x-shellscript"

    def _line_count(self) -> Any:
        if not statmod.S_ISREG(self.path.stat().st_mode if self.path.exists() else 0):
            try:
                if not self.path.is_file():
                    return ""
            except OSError:
                return ""
        try:
            with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                return handle.read().count(b"\n")
        except OSError:
            return ""

    def _hash_file(self, algorithm: str) -> str:
        if not statmod.S_ISREG(self.path.stat().st_mode if self.path.exists() else 0):
            return ""
        hasher = hashlib.new(algorithm)
        try:
            with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                while True:
                    chunk = handle.read(65536)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    hasher.update(chunk)
            return hasher.hexdigest()
        except OSError:
            return ""

    def _has_extension(self, extensions: set[str]) -> bool:
        return self.path.suffix.lower() in extensions

    def _image_dimensions(self) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        if self.path.suffix.lower() == ".png":
            try:
                with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                    header = handle.read(24)
                if header.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
                    return int.from_bytes(header[16:20], "big"), int.from_bytes(header[20:24], "big")
            except OSError:
                pass
        if self.path.suffix.lower() == ".gif":
            try:
                with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
                    header = handle.read(10)
                if header[:6] in {b"GIF87a", b"GIF89a"}:
                    return int.from_bytes(header[6:8], "little"), int.from_bytes(header[8:10], "little")
            except OSError:
                pass
        if self.path.suffix.lower() == ".svg":
            try:
                text = self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            except OSError:
                return "", ""
            width = re.search(r'width="(\d+)', text)
            height = re.search(r'height="(\d+)', text)
            return (width.group(1) if width else "", height.group(1) if height else "")
        return "", ""


def split_name_ext(name: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if name.startswith(".") and name.count(".") == 1:
        return name, ""
    if "." not in name:
        return name, ""
    filename, ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)
    return filename, ext


def pascal_case(name: str) -> str:
    return "".join(part[:1].upper() + part[1:] for part in re.split(r"_+", name) if part)


def canonical_field_name(name: str) -> str:
    return FIELD_SYNONYMS.get(name.lower(), name.lower())


def canonical_function_name(name: str) -> str:
    lowered = name.lower()
    return FUNCTION_ALIASES.get(lowered, lowered)


def truthy(value: Any) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value in (None, "", 0, 0.0):
        return False
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.lower()
        if lowered in BOOLEAN_FALSE:
            return False
        if lowered in BOOLEAN_TRUE:
            return True
    return bool(value)


def to_number(value: Any) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return 1.0 if value else 0.0
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    if value in (None, ""):
        return 0.0
    text = str(value).strip()
    size_value = parse_size_literal(text)
    if size_value is not None:
        return float(size_value)
    try:
        return float(text)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0


def stringify_value(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if value.is_integer():
            return str(int(value))
        return str(value)
    return str(value)


def format_datetime(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.strftime(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)


def format_size(value: float, spec: str = "") -> str:
    amount = float(value)
    spec = (spec or "").strip()
    decimals = 2
    base = 1024
    use_conventional_units = False
    unit_override = None
    short_units = False
    use_space = " " in spec
    if match := re.search(r"%\.(\d+)", spec):
        decimals = int(match.group(1))
    if " d" in f" {spec}" or spec.endswith("d"):
        base = 1000
    if " c" in f" {spec}" or spec.endswith("c") or " c" in spec:
        use_conventional_units = True
    if " s" in f" {spec}" or spec.endswith("s"):
        short_units = True
    unit_match = re.search(r"\b(tib|tb|gib|gb|mib|mb|kib|kb|t|g|m|k)\b", spec)
    if unit_match:
        unit_override = unit_match.group(1)

    binary_units = ["B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB"]
    decimal_units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]
    short_binary_units = ["B", "K", "M", "G", "T"]

    units = decimal_units if use_conventional_units or base == 1000 else binary_units
    if short_units:
        units = short_binary_units

    unit_index = 0
    if unit_override:
        unit_map = {"k": 1, "kib": 1, "kb": 1, "m": 2, "mib": 2, "mb": 2, "g": 3, "gib": 3, "gb": 3, "t": 4, "tib": 4, "tb": 4}
        unit_index = unit_map[unit_override]
        divisor = 1000 if unit_override in {"kb", "mb", "gb", "tb"} else 1024
        amount = float(value) / (divisor ** unit_index)
        if use_conventional_units:
            units = decimal_units if not short_units else short_binary_units
    else:
        while abs(amount) >= base and unit_index < len(units) - 1:
            amount /= base
            unit_index += 1

    if unit_index == 0:
        text = str(int(round(amount))) if amount == int(amount) else f"{amount:.{decimals}f}"
    else:
        text = f"{amount:.{decimals}f}"
        if decimals == 0:
            text = str(int(round(amount)))
    separator = " " if use_space else ""
    return f"{text}{separator}{units[unit_index]}"


def format_duration(seconds: float) -> str:
    total = int(seconds)
    if total < 60:
        return f"{total}s"
    minutes, sec = divmod(total, 60)
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    days, hours = divmod(hours, 24)
    parts: list[str] = []
    if days:
        parts.append(f"{days}d")
    if hours:
        parts.append(f"{hours}h")
    if minutes:
        parts.append(f"{minutes}m")
    if sec or not parts:
        parts.append(f"{sec}s")
    return " ".join(parts)


def parse_size_literal(text: str) -> Optional[int]:
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([a-zA-Z]+)", text.strip())
    if not match:
        return None
    number = float(match.group(1))
    unit = match.group(2).lower()
    factors = {
        "b": 1,
        "k": 1024,
        "kib": 1024,
        "kb": 1000,
        "m": 1024**2,
        "mib": 1024**2,
        "mb": 1000**2,
        "g": 1024**3,
        "gib": 1024**3,
        "gb": 1000**3,
        "t": 1024**4,
        "tib": 1024**4,
        "tb": 1000**4,
    }
    factor = factors.get(unit)
    if factor is None:
        return None
    return int(number * factor)


MONTH_LOOKUP = {name.lower(): index for index, name in enumerate(
    ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"],
    start=1,
)}
MONTH_LOOKUP.update({name[:3].lower(): index for name, index in MONTH_LOOKUP.items() if len(name) > 3})
WEEKDAY_LOOKUP = {
    "mon": 0,
    "monday": 0,
    "tue": 1,
    "tuesday": 1,
    "wed": 2,
    "wednesday": 2,
    "thu": 3,
    "thursday": 3,
    "fri": 4,
    "friday": 4,
    "sat": 5,
    "saturday": 5,
    "sun": 6,
    "sunday": 6,
}


def parse_datetime_value(value: Any, us_dates: bool) -> Optional[datetime]:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(float(value))
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    text = str(value).strip().strip("'")
    now = datetime.now()

    if text.lower() == "today":
        return datetime(now.year, now.month, now.day)
    if text.lower() == "yesterday":
        day = now - timedelta(days=1)
        return datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day)
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", text):
        return now + timedelta(days=int(text))
    if text.lower() == "last week":
        return now - timedelta(days=7)
    if text.lower().startswith("last "):
        weekday = WEEKDAY_LOOKUP.get(text.lower()[5:])
        if weekday is not None:
            days = (now.weekday() - weekday) % 7 or 7
            target = now - timedelta(days=days)
            return datetime(target.year, target.month, target.day)
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", text):
        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%d")
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}", text):
        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%d %H")
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}", text):
        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", text):
        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}", text):
        first, second = text.split("/")
        month = int(first) if us_dates else int(second)
        day = int(second) if us_dates else int(first)
        return datetime(now.year, month, day)
    if match := re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2})", text):
        month = MONTH_LOOKUP.get(match.group(1).lower())
        if month:
            return datetime(now.year, month, int(match.group(2)))
    try:
        return datetime.strptime(text, DATE_TIME_FORMAT)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def parse_date_interval(value: Any, us_dates: bool) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, datetime]]:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    text = str(value).strip().strip("'")
    dt = parse_datetime_value(text, us_dates)
    if dt is None:
        return None
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", text) or text.lower() in {"today", "yesterday"} or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z]{3,9}\s+\d{1,2}", text) or re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}", text):
        end = dt + timedelta(days=1) - timedelta(seconds=1)
        return dt, end
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}", text):
        end = dt + timedelta(hours=1) - timedelta(seconds=1)
        return dt, end
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}", text):
        end = dt + timedelta(minutes=1) - timedelta(seconds=1)
        return dt, end
    return dt, dt


def extract_date_part(value: Any, part: str) -> Any:
    dt = parse_datetime_value(value, False)
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    if part == "day":
        return dt.day
    if part == "month":
        return dt.month
    if part == "year":
        return dt.year
    if part == "dow":
        return ((dt.weekday() + 1) % 7) + 1
    if part == "dayname":
        return dt.strftime("%A")
    if part == "doy":
        return dt.timetuple().tm_yday
    return ""


def compare_values(env: EvalEnv, left: Any, right: Any, left_expr: Expr, right_expr: Expr, op: str) -> bool:
    if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", "===", "eeq", "!==", "ene", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "le", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "ge"}:
        if isinstance(left_expr, FieldExpr) and canonical_field_name(left_expr.name) in DATE_FIELDS:
            interval = parse_date_interval(right, env.runtime.us_dates)
            exact = parse_datetime_value(right, env.runtime.us_dates)
            left_dt = parse_datetime_value(left, env.runtime.us_dates)
            if left_dt is not None and interval is not None:
                if op in {"=", "==", "eq"}:
                    return interval[0] <= left_dt <= interval[1]
                if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne"}:
                    return not (interval[0] <= left_dt <= interval[1])
            if left_dt is not None and exact is not None:
                return compare_simple(left_dt, exact, op)

        if isinstance(left_expr, FieldExpr) and canonical_field_name(left_expr.name) in UNIX_TIME_FIELDS:
            return compare_simple(to_number(left), to_number(right), op)

        size_literal = parse_size_literal(stringify_value(right))
        if size_literal is not None:
            return compare_simple(to_number(left), float(size_literal), op)

        if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne"}:
            right_text = stringify_value(right)
            left_text = stringify_value(left)
            if any(ch in right_text for ch in "*?["):
                result = fnmatch.fnmatchcase(left_text, right_text)
                return not result if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne"} else result
        return compare_simple(left, right, op)

    if op in {"=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx"}:
        try:
            return re.search(stringify_value(right), stringify_value(left)) is not None
        except re.error:
            return False
    if op in {"!=~", "!~=", "notrx"}:
        try:
            return re.search(stringify_value(right), stringify_value(left)) is None
        except re.error:
            return False
    if op == "like":
        pattern = sql_like_to_regex(stringify_value(right))
        return re.search(pattern, stringify_value(left)) is not None
    if op == "notlike":
        pattern = sql_like_to_regex(stringify_value(right))
        return re.search(pattern, stringify_value(left)) is None
    raise ParseError(f"Unsupported operator {op}")


def compare_simple(left: Any, right: Any, op: str) -> bool:
    if isinstance(left, bool) or isinstance(right, bool):
        left = truthy(left)
        right = truthy(right)
    elif any(isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in (left, right)):
        left = to_number(left)
        right = to_number(right)
    else:
        left = stringify_value(left)
        right = stringify_value(right)
    if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "===", "eeq"}:
        return left == right
    if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne", "!==", "ene"}:
        return left != right
    if op in {"<", "lt"}:
        return left < right
    if op in {"<=", "lte", "le"}:
        return left <= right
    if op in {">", "gt"}:
        return left > right
    if op in {">=", "gte", "ge"}:
        return left >= right
    raise ParseError(f"Unsupported operator {op}")


def sql_like_to_regex(pattern: str) -> str:
    escaped = []
    for char in pattern:
        if char == "%":
            escaped.append(".*")
        elif char == "_":
            escaped.append(".")
        else:
            escaped.append(re.escape(char))
    return "".join(escaped)


def equal_for_in(env: EvalEnv, left: Any, right: Any, left_expr: Expr) -> bool:
    return compare_values(env, left, right, left_expr, LiteralExpr(right), "=")


def evaluate_aggregate(
    canonical: str,
    args: list[Expr],
    rows: list[FileRow],
    runtime: Runtime,
    outer_alias_rows: dict[str, FileRow],
) -> Any:
    values: list[Any] = []
    if canonical == "count" and args and isinstance(args[0], StarExpr):
        return len(rows)
    for row in rows:
        env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)}, group_rows=rows)
        values.append(args[0].eval(env) if args else "")

    if canonical == "count":
        return sum(1 for value in values if value not in (None, ""))
    if not values:
        return ""
    if canonical == "min":
        return min(values)
    if canonical == "max":
        return max(values)
    if canonical == "sum":
        return sum(to_number(value) for value in values)
    if canonical == "avg":
        nums = [to_number(value) for value in values]
        return sum(nums) / len(nums) if nums else ""
    nums = [to_number(value) for value in values]
    if canonical in {"var_pop", "variance", "stddev_pop", "stddev", "std"}:
        if not nums:
            return ""
        mean = sum(nums) / len(nums)
        variance = sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in nums) / len(nums)
        return math.sqrt(variance) if canonical in {"stddev_pop", "stddev", "std"} else variance
    if canonical in {"var_samp", "stddev_samp"}:
        if len(nums) < 2:
            return ""
        mean = sum(nums) / len(nums)
        variance = sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in nums) / (len(nums) - 1)
        return math.sqrt(variance) if canonical == "stddev_samp" else variance
    return ""


def alias_rows_for_row(row: FileRow) -> dict[str, FileRow]:
    aliases: dict[str, FileRow] = {}
    if row.root.alias:
        aliases[row.root.alias.lower()] = row
    return aliases


def parse_runtime_options(argv: list[str]) -> RuntimeOptions:
    options = RuntimeOptions()
    index = 0
    while index < len(argv):
        arg = argv[index]
        if arg in {"--interactive", "-i"}:
            options.interactive = True
        elif arg in {"--nocolor", "--no-color"}:
            options.no_color = True
        elif arg == "--no-errors":
            options.no_errors = True
        elif arg == "--us-dates":
            options.us_dates = True
        elif arg in {"--help", "-h"}:
            options.help_requested = True
        elif arg in {"--version", "-V"}:
            options.version_requested = True
        elif arg in {"--config", "-c"}:
            if index + 1 >= len(argv):
                raise ParseError("Expected config file path")
            options.config_path = Path(argv[index + 1])
            index += 1
        else:
            options.query_parts = argv[index:]
            break
        index += 1
    return options


def create_default_config() -> Config:
    config = Config()
    parsed = parse_simple_toml(DEFAULT_CONFIG_TEMPLATE)
    config.no_color = bool(parsed.get("no_color", False))
    config.gitignore = bool(parsed.get("gitignore", False))
    config.hgignore = bool(parsed.get("hgignore", False))
    config.dockerignore = bool(parsed.get("dockerignore", False))
    config.default_file_size_format = str(parsed.get("default_file_size_format", ""))
    config.us_dates = bool(parsed.get("us_dates", False))
    config.check_for_updates = bool(parsed.get("check_for_updates", False))
    config.type_lists = {key: {item.lower() for item in parsed.get(key, [])} for key in CATEGORY_KEYS}
    return config


def parse_simple_toml(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    lines = iter(text.splitlines())
    for raw_line in lines:
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = [part.strip() for part in line.split("=", 1)]
        if value == "[":
            items: list[str] = []
            for inner in lines:
                inner_line = inner.strip()
                if inner_line == "]":
                    break
                inner_line = inner_line.rstrip(",").strip()
                if inner_line.startswith('"') and inner_line.endswith('"'):
                    items.append(inner_line[1:-1])
            result[key] = items
        elif value.startswith("["):
            items = [item.strip().strip('"') for item in value.strip("[]").split(",") if item.strip()]
            result[key] = items
        elif value in {"true", "false"}:
            result[key] = value == "true"
        elif value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
            result[key] = value[1:-1]
        else:
            result[key] = value
    return result


def ensure_config(options: RuntimeOptions) -> tuple[Config, Optional[str], Path]:
    config = create_default_config()
    home = Path.home()
    default_path = home / ".config" / "fselect" / "config.toml"
    target_path = options.config_path if options.config_path is not None else default_path

    if options.config_path is None:
        if not target_path.exists():
            target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target_path.write_text(DEFAULT_CONFIG_TEMPLATE, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        if not target_path.exists():
            return config, "Could not open config file. Using default settings.\n", target_path

    try:
        parsed = parse_simple_toml(target_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except OSError:
        if options.config_path is not None:
            return config, "Could not open config file. Using default settings.\n", target_path
        return config, None, target_path

    config.no_color = bool(parsed.get("no_color", config.no_color))
    config.gitignore = bool(parsed.get("gitignore", config.gitignore))
    config.hgignore = bool(parsed.get("hgignore", config.hgignore))
    config.dockerignore = bool(parsed.get("dockerignore", config.dockerignore))
    config.default_file_size_format = str(parsed.get("default_file_size_format", config.default_file_size_format))
    config.us_dates = bool(parsed.get("us_dates", config.us_dates))
    config.check_for_updates = bool(parsed.get("check_for_updates", config.check_for_updates))
    for key in CATEGORY_KEYS:
        if key in parsed:
            config.type_lists[key] = {str(item).lower() for item in parsed[key]}
    return config, None, target_path


def history_path_for(config_path: Path) -> Path:
    return config_path.with_name("history.txt")


def append_history(config_path: Path, line: str) -> None:
    path = history_path_for(config_path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not path.exists():
        path.write_text("#V2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(f"{line}\n")


def tokenize(query: str) -> list[Token]:
    tokens: list[Token] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(query):
        char = query[index]
        if char.isspace():
            index += 1
            continue
        if char in "'\"`":
            quote = char
            index += 1
            buffer: list[str] = []
            while index < len(query):
                current = query[index]
                if current == "\\" and index + 1 < len(query):
                    buffer.append(query[index + 1])
                    index += 2
                    continue
                if current == quote:
                    index += 1
                    break
                buffer.append(current)
                index += 1
            tokens.append(Token("".join(buffer), kind="string", quoted=True))
            continue
        if char in "(),":
            tokens.append(Token(char, kind=char))
            index += 1
            continue
        if char == "{":
            tokens.append(Token("(", kind="("))
            index += 1
            continue
        if char == "}":
            tokens.append(Token(")", kind=")"))
            index += 1
            continue
        for operator in ("!==", "!=~", "!~=", "===", "<=", ">=", "==", "!=", "<>", "=~", "~="):
            if query.startswith(operator, index):
                tokens.append(Token(operator, kind="op"))
                index += len(operator)
                break
        else:
            if char in "=<>!~":
                tokens.append(Token(char, kind="op"))
                index += 1
                continue
            if char in "+-*/%" and is_standalone_arithmetic(query, index):
                tokens.append(Token(char, kind="op"))
                index += 1
                continue

            start = index
            while index < len(query):
                current = query[index]
                if current.isspace() or current in "(),{}":
                    break
                if current in "=<>!~":
                    break
                if current in "+-*/%" and is_standalone_arithmetic(query, index):
                    break
                index += 1
            tokens.append(Token(query[start:index]))
            continue
        continue
    return tokens


def is_standalone_arithmetic(text: str, index: int) -> bool:
    current = text[index]
    prev = previous_nonspace(text, index - 1)
    next_char = next_nonspace(text, index + 1)
    if current in "+-" and (prev in {None, "(", ","} and next_char is not None and (next_char.isdigit() or next_char == ".")):
        return False
    left_break = prev is None or prev.isspace() or prev in "(),{}"
    right_break = next_char is None or next_char.isspace() or next_char in "(),{}"
    return left_break and right_break


def previous_nonspace(text: str, index: int) -> Optional[str]:
    while index >= 0:
        if not text[index].isspace():
            return text[index]
        index -= 1
    return None


def next_nonspace(text: str, index: int) -> Optional[str]:
    while index < len(text):
        if not text[index].isspace():
            return text[index]
        index += 1
    return None


class Parser:
    CLAUSE_KEYWORDS = {"from", "where", "group", "order", "limit", "offset", "into"}

    def __init__(self, tokens: list[Token], raw_query: str) -> None:
        self.stream = TokenStream(tokens)
        self.raw_query = raw_query

    def parse(self) -> Query:
        self.stream.match("select")
        select_exprs = self.parse_expression_list(stop_keywords=self.CLAUSE_KEYWORDS, unknown_as_field=False)
        roots: list[RootSpec] = []
        where_expr: Optional[Expr] = None
        group_by: list[Expr] = []
        order_by: list[OrderSpec] = []
        limit: Optional[int] = None
        offset = 0
        fmt = "tabs"

        while not self.stream.at_end():
            if self.stream.match("from"):
                roots = self.parse_roots()
            elif self.stream.match("where"):
                where_expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=True)
            elif self.stream.match("group"):
                self.stream.expect("by")
                group_by = self.parse_expression_list(stop_keywords={"order", "limit", "offset", "into"}, unknown_as_field=False)
            elif self.stream.match("order"):
                self.stream.expect("by")
                order_by = self.parse_order_list()
            elif self.stream.match("limit"):
                limit = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
            elif self.stream.match("offset"):
                offset = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
            elif self.stream.match("into"):
                token = self.stream.next()
                fmt = token.value.lower()
            else:
                unexpected = self.stream.next().value
                raise ParseError(f"Unexpected token {unexpected}")

        return Query(
            select_exprs=select_exprs,
            roots=roots,
            where_expr=where_expr,
            group_by=group_by,
            order_by=order_by,
            limit=limit,
            offset=offset,
            fmt=fmt,
            raw_query=self.raw_query,
        )

    def parse_roots(self) -> list[RootSpec]:
        roots: list[RootSpec] = []
        while True:
            roots.append(self.parse_root())
            if not self.stream.match(","):
                break
        return roots

    def parse_root(self) -> RootSpec:
        token = self.stream.next()
        if token.kind not in {"word", "string"}:
            raise ParseError("Expected root path")
        root = RootSpec(path=token.value)
        while True:
            next_token = self.stream.peek()
            if next_token is None:
                break
            lowered = next_token.lower()
            if lowered in self.CLAUSE_KEYWORDS or lowered == ",":
                break
            self.stream.next()
            if lowered == "mindepth":
                root.mindepth = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
            elif lowered in {"maxdepth", "depth"}:
                root.maxdepth = int(to_number(self.parse_primary(False).eval(EvalEnv(runtime=Runtime(Path.cwd(), create_default_config())))))
            elif lowered in {"symlinks", "sym"}:
                root.symlinks = True
            elif lowered in {"archives", "arc"}:
                root.archives = True
            elif lowered in {"gitignore", "git"}:
                root.gitignore = True
            elif lowered in {"nogitignore", "nogit"}:
                root.gitignore = False
            elif lowered in {"hgignore", "hg"}:
                root.hgignore = True
            elif lowered in {"nohgignore", "nohg"}:
                root.hgignore = False
            elif lowered in {"dockerignore", "docker", "dock"}:
                root.dockerignore = True
            elif lowered in {"nodockerignore", "nodocker", "nodock"}:
                root.dockerignore = False
            elif lowered == "dfs":
                root.dfs = True
                root.bfs = False
            elif lowered == "bfs":
                root.bfs = True
                root.dfs = False
            elif lowered in {"regexp", "rx"}:
                root.regexp = True
            elif lowered == "as":
                root.alias = self.stream.expect_identifier()
            else:
                # Bare alias is not supported; unknown path options are ignored like the original parser often does.
                pass
        return root

    def parse_order_list(self) -> list[OrderSpec]:
        items: list[OrderSpec] = []
        while True:
            token = self.stream.peek()
            if token is None:
                break
            positional_index: Optional[int] = None
            if token.kind in {"word", "string"} and re.fullmatch(r"\d+", token.value):
                positional_index = int(token.value)
                expr: Expr = LiteralExpr(positional_index, raw=token.value)
                self.stream.next()
            else:
                expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=False)
            desc = False
            if self.stream.match("desc"):
                desc = True
            else:
                self.stream.match("asc")
            items.append(OrderSpec(expr=expr, desc=desc, positional_index=positional_index))
            if not self.stream.match(","):
                break
        return items

    def parse_expression_list(self, stop_keywords: set[str], unknown_as_field: bool) -> list[Expr]:
        expressions: list[Expr] = []
        while True:
            token = self.stream.peek()
            if token is None:
                break
            if token.lower() in stop_keywords:
                break
            expressions.append(self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field=unknown_as_field))
            token = self.stream.peek()
            if token is None or token.lower() in stop_keywords:
                break
            self.stream.match(",")
        if not expressions:
            raise ParseError("Expected columns")
        return expressions

    def parse_or_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_and_expression(unknown_as_field)
        while self.stream.match("or"):
            expr = BinaryExpr("or", expr, self.parse_and_expression(unknown_as_field))
        return expr

    def parse_and_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field)
        while self.stream.match("and"):
            expr = BinaryExpr("and", expr, self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field))
        return expr

    def parse_not_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        if self.stream.match("not"):
            if self.stream.match("exists"):
                subquery = self.parse_subquery()
                return ExistsExpr(subquery, negated=True)
            return UnaryExpr("not", self.parse_not_expression(unknown_as_field))
        if self.stream.match("exists"):
            subquery = self.parse_subquery()
            return ExistsExpr(subquery, negated=False)
        return self.parse_comparison_expression(unknown_as_field)

    def parse_comparison_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_additive_expression(unknown_as_field)
        token = self.stream.peek()
        if token is None:
            return expr
        lowered = token.lower()

        if lowered == "between":
            self.stream.next()
            low = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
            self.stream.expect("and")
            high = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
            return BetweenExpr(expr, low, high)
        if lowered == "not" and self.stream.peek(1) and self.stream.peek(1).lower() == "between":
            self.stream.next()
            self.stream.next()
            low = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
            self.stream.expect("and")
            high = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
            return BetweenExpr(expr, low, high, negated=True)
        if lowered == "in":
            self.stream.next()
            return self.parse_in_expression(expr, negated=False)
        if lowered == "not" and self.stream.peek(1) and self.stream.peek(1).lower() == "in":
            self.stream.next()
            self.stream.next()
            return self.parse_in_expression(expr, negated=True)
        if lowered in {"like", "notlike", "=", "==", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", "===", "eeq", "!==", "ene", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "le", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "ge", "=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx", "!=~", "!~=", "notrx"}:
            op = self.stream.next().lower()
            right = self.parse_additive_expression(False)
            return BinaryExpr(op, expr, right)
        return expr

    def parse_in_expression(self, expr: Expr, negated: bool) -> Expr:
        self.stream.expect("(")
        if self.stream.peek() and self.stream.peek().lower() == "select":
            subquery = self.parse_subquery_contents()
            self.stream.expect(")")
            return InExpr(expr, subquery=subquery, negated=negated)
        items: list[Expr] = []
        while True:
            items.append(self.parse_or_expression(False))
            if not self.stream.match(","):
                break
        self.stream.expect(")")
        return InExpr(expr, options=items, negated=negated)

    def parse_subquery(self) -> Query:
        self.stream.expect("(")
        query = self.parse_subquery_contents()
        self.stream.expect(")")
        return query

    def parse_subquery_contents(self) -> Query:
        depth = 0
        start = self.stream.index
        index = self.stream.index
        while index < len(self.stream.tokens):
            token = self.stream.tokens[index]
            if token.value == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif token.value == ")":
                if depth == 0:
                    break
                depth -= 1
            index += 1
        inner_tokens = self.stream.tokens[start:index]
        self.stream.index = index
        return Parser(inner_tokens, " ".join(token.value for token in inner_tokens)).parse()

    def parse_additive_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field)
        while True:
            if self.stream.match("+", "plus"):
                expr = BinaryExpr("+", expr, self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field))
            elif self.stream.match("-", "minus"):
                expr = BinaryExpr("-", expr, self.parse_multiplicative_expression(unknown_as_field))
            else:
                break
        return expr

    def parse_multiplicative_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field)
        while True:
            if self.stream.match("*", "mul"):
                expr = BinaryExpr("*", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
            elif self.stream.match("/", "div"):
                expr = BinaryExpr("/", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
            elif self.stream.match("%", "mod"):
                expr = BinaryExpr("%", expr, self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
            else:
                break
        return expr

    def parse_unary_expression(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        if self.stream.match("+"):
            return UnaryExpr("+", self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
        if self.stream.match("-"):
            return UnaryExpr("-", self.parse_unary_expression(unknown_as_field))
        return self.parse_primary(unknown_as_field)

    def parse_primary(self, unknown_as_field: bool) -> Expr:
        token = self.stream.peek()
        if token is None:
            raise ParseError("Unexpected end of query")
        if token.value == "(":
            self.stream.next()
            expr = self.parse_or_expression(unknown_as_field)
            self.stream.expect(")")
            return expr
        if token.kind == "string":
            self.stream.next()
            return LiteralExpr(token.value, raw=token.value)
        if token.value == "*":
            self.stream.next()
            return StarExpr()

        word = self.stream.next()
        lowered = word.lower()

        if self.stream.peek() and self.stream.peek().value == "(":
            self.stream.next()
            args: list[Expr] = []
            if not self.stream.match(")"):
                while True:
                    args.append(self.parse_or_expression(False))
                    if self.stream.match(")"):
                        break
                    self.stream.expect(",")
            return FunctionExpr(word.value, args)

        if lowered in NO_ARG_FUNCTIONS:
            return FunctionExpr(word.value, [])
        if lowered in BOOLEAN_TRUE:
            return LiteralExpr(True, raw=word.value)
        if lowered in BOOLEAN_FALSE:
            return LiteralExpr(False, raw=word.value)
        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", word.value):
            if "." in word.value:
                return LiteralExpr(float(word.value), raw=word.value)
            return LiteralExpr(int(word.value), raw=word.value)
        if "." in word.value and not word.value.startswith(".") and not word.value.endswith(".") and "/" not in word.value:
            alias, field_name = word.value.split(".", 1)
            return FieldExpr(field_name, alias=alias)
        if word.kind == "string":
            return LiteralExpr(word.value, raw=word.value)
        if unknown_as_field or lowered in KNOWN_FIELDS:
            return FieldExpr(word.value)
        return LiteralExpr(word.value, raw=word.value)


def execute_query(query: Query, runtime: Runtime, outer_alias_rows: Optional[dict[str, FileRow]] = None) -> ResultTable:
    outer_alias_rows = outer_alias_rows or {}
    rows = scan_rows(query, runtime)
    filtered: list[FileRow] = []
    for row in rows:
        env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
        if query.where_expr is None or truthy(query.where_expr.eval(env)):
            filtered.append(row)

    labels = [expr.label() for expr in query.select_exprs]
    result_rows: list[ResultRow] = []

    if query.group_by:
        grouped: dict[tuple[Any, ...], list[FileRow]] = {}
        for row in filtered:
            env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
            key = tuple(expr.eval(env) for expr in query.group_by)
            grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(row)
        for group_rows in grouped.values():
            current = group_rows[0]
            env = EvalEnv(
                runtime=runtime,
                current_row=current,
                alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(current)},
                group_rows=group_rows,
            )
            values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
            result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=current))
    elif query.has_aggregate():
        current = filtered[0] if filtered else None
        env = EvalEnv(
            runtime=runtime,
            current_row=current,
            alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **(alias_rows_for_row(current) if current else {})},
            group_rows=filtered,
        )
        values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
        result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=current))
    else:
        for row in filtered:
            env = EvalEnv(runtime=runtime, current_row=row, alias_rows={**outer_alias_rows, **alias_rows_for_row(row)})
            values = [expr.eval(env) for expr in query.select_exprs]
            result_rows.append(ResultRow(values=values, labels=labels, alias_rows=env.alias_rows, current_row=row))

    if query.order_by:
        def sort_key(result_row: ResultRow) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
            values: list[Any] = []
            for spec in query.order_by:
                if spec.positional_index is not None:
                    idx = spec.positional_index - 1
                    value = result_row.values[idx] if 0 <= idx < len(result_row.values) else ""
                else:
                    env = EvalEnv(
                        runtime=runtime,
                        current_row=result_row.current_row,
                        alias_rows=result_row.alias_rows,
                        group_rows=[result_row.current_row] if result_row.current_row else [],
                    )
                    value = spec.expr.eval(env)
                values.append(value)
            return tuple(normalize_sort_value(v) for v in values)

        for spec_index in range(len(query.order_by) - 1, -1, -1):
            spec = query.order_by[spec_index]
            result_rows.sort(
                key=lambda row, idx=spec_index: normalize_sort_value(
                    row.values[query.order_by[idx].positional_index - 1]
                    if query.order_by[idx].positional_index is not None and 0 <= query.order_by[idx].positional_index - 1 < len(row.values)
                    else EvalEnv(
                        runtime=runtime,
                        current_row=row.current_row,
                        alias_rows=row.alias_rows,
                        group_rows=[row.current_row] if row.current_row else [],
                    ).call_function("coalesce", [query.order_by[idx].expr])
                ),
                reverse=spec.desc,
            )

    if query.offset:
        result_rows = result_rows[query.offset :]
    if query.limit is not None:
        result_rows = result_rows[: query.limit]

    return ResultTable(rows=result_rows, labels=labels, raw_query=query.raw_query, fmt=query.fmt)


def normalize_sort_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return value


def scan_rows(query: Query, runtime: Runtime) -> list[FileRow]:
    roots = query.roots or [RootSpec(path=".")]
    rows: list[FileRow] = []
    for root in roots:
        rows.extend(scan_root(root, runtime))
    return rows


def scan_root(root: RootSpec, runtime: Runtime) -> list[FileRow]:
    candidate = Path(root.path)
    if not candidate.is_absolute():
        candidate = runtime.cwd / candidate
    try:
        resolved = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: could not canonicalize path: No such file or directory (os error 2)")
    if not resolved.is_dir():
        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: Not a directory (os error 20)")

    rows: list[FileRow] = []
    pending: deque[tuple[Path, int]] = deque()
    try:
        entries = list(os.scandir(resolved))
    except OSError as exc:
        raise QueryIOError(f"{root.path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})")

    for entry in entries:
        pending.append((Path(entry.path), 1))

    while pending:
        path, depth = pending.pop() if root.dfs else pending.popleft()
        rel_path = os.path.relpath(path, resolved)
        row = FileRow(runtime, root, resolved, path, rel_path)
        if depth >= root.mindepth and (root.maxdepth is None or depth <= root.maxdepth):
            rows.append(row)
        if root.maxdepth is not None and depth >= root.maxdepth:
            continue
        try:
            if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink():
                for child in os.scandir(path):
                    pending.append((Path(child.path), depth + 1))
        except OSError as exc:
            raise QueryIOError(f"{path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})")
    return rows


def format_result(table: ResultTable) -> str:
    fmt = table.fmt.lower()
    if fmt == "tabs":
        if not table.rows:
            return ""
        return "".join("\t".join(stringify_value(value) for value in row.values) + "\n" for row in table.rows)
    if fmt == "lines":
        if not table.rows:
            return ""
        return "".join("".join(stringify_value(value) + "\n" for value in row.values) for row in table.rows)
    if fmt == "list":
        return "".join("".join(stringify_value(value) + "\0" for value in row.values) for row in table.rows)
    if fmt == "csv":
        output = []
        for row in table.rows:
            buffer = []
            for value in row.values:
                buffer.append(stringify_value(value))
            output.append(buffer)
        from io import StringIO

        handle = StringIO()
        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerows(output)
        return handle.getvalue()
    if fmt == "json":
        objects = []
        for row in table.rows:
            pairs = sorted(zip(row.labels, row.values), key=lambda pair: pair[0])
            objects.append({label: stringify_value(value) for label, value in pairs})
        return json.dumps(objects, separators=(",", ":"))
    if fmt == "html":
        cell_rows = []
        for row in table.rows:
            cells = "".join(f"<td>{html.escape(stringify_value(value))}</td>" for value in row.values)
            cell_rows.append(f"<tr>{cells}</tr>")
        title = html.escape(table.raw_query)
        return f"<html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><table><tr><th colspan=\"{max(1, len(table.labels))}\">{title}</th></tr>{''.join(cell_rows)}</table></body></html>"
    return format_result(ResultTable(rows=table.rows, labels=table.labels, raw_query=table.raw_query, fmt="tabs"))


def run_query(query_text: str, runtime: Runtime) -> str:
    tokens = tokenize(query_text)
    if not tokens:
        raise ParseError("Unexpected end of query")
    parser = Parser(tokens, query_text)
    query = parser.parse()
    table = execute_query(query, runtime)
    return format_result(table)


def interactive_loop(runtime: Runtime, config_path: Path) -> int:
    while True:
        try:
            line = input("query> ")
        except EOFError:
            print("CTRL-D")
            return 0
        append_history(config_path, line)
        stripped = line.strip()
        lowered = stripped.lower()
        if lowered in {"exit", "quit"}:
            return 0
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if lowered == "help":
            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
            continue
        if lowered == "pwd":
            print(runtime.cwd)
            continue
        if lowered.startswith("cd "):
            target = stripped[3:].strip()
            candidate = Path(target)
            if not candidate.is_absolute():
                candidate = runtime.cwd / candidate
            try:
                runtime.cwd = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
            except OSError:
                pass
            continue
        if lowered in {"errors", "errors on"}:
            runtime.no_errors = False
            print("Errors are ON")
            continue
        if lowered == "errors off":
            runtime.no_errors = True
            print("Errors are OFF")
            continue
        try:
            output = run_query(stripped, runtime)
            sys.stdout.write(output)
        except ParseError as exc:
            if not runtime.no_errors:
                print(f"query: {exc}")
        except QueryIOError as exc:
            if not runtime.no_errors:
                print(exc)


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        options = parse_runtime_options(argv)
    except ParseError as exc:
        print(f"query: {exc}")
        return 2

    config, warning, config_path = ensure_config(options)
    config.no_color = config.no_color or options.no_color or bool(os.environ.get("NO_COLOR"))
    us_dates = options.us_dates or config.us_dates
    runtime = Runtime(cwd=Path.cwd(), config=config, no_errors=options.no_errors, us_dates=us_dates)

    if options.interactive:
        if warning:
            sys.stdout.write(warning)
        return interactive_loop(runtime, config_path)
    if options.help_requested:
        sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
        return 0
    if options.version_requested or not options.query_parts:
        sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
        return 0

    if warning:
        sys.stdout.write(warning)

    query_text = " ".join(options.query_parts)
    try:
        output = run_query(query_text, runtime)
    except ParseError as exc:
        if not runtime.no_errors:
            print(f"query: {exc}")
        return 2
    except QueryIOError as exc:
        if not runtime.no_errors:
            print(exc)
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write(output)
    return 0


def _expect_identifier(self: TokenStream) -> str:
    token = self.next()
    return token.value


TokenStream.expect_identifier = _expect_identifier  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
